title: Unit 7 Consolidation: Temporal Subordination
goal: Consolidate temporal conjunctions (en cuanto, hasta que, mientras, cada vez que, antes de que) and analyze Gabriel García Márquez's 'El coronel no tiene quien le escriba'.
grammar: síntesis de subordinación temporal de prospección, límites y asimetrías modales

items: Govern subjunctive complements in prospective temporal clauses (en cuanto, tan pronto como, apenas).
Set temporal boundaries and terminal conditions with 'hasta que' and 'hasta no'.
Distinguish durative simultaneity from conditional restriction with 'mientras'.
Master the obligatory subjunctive after 'antes de que' and mood alternation in 'después de que'.
Analyze literary waiting and temporal anticipation in Gabriel García Márquez's classic masterpiece.
I can coordinate prospective future events using 'en cuanto' and 'tan pronto como' with the subjunctive.
I can establish deadlines and boundaries using 'hasta que' in the subjunctive.
I can use 'mientras' to express both factual simultaneity (indicative) and conditional duration (subjunctive).
I can apply the invariable rule requiring the subjunctive after 'antes de que'.
